title: Geomorphological map showing the coastal systems within the Dongola quadrangle
citation: DuBar, J.R., 1987, Geomorphological map showing the coastal systems within the Dongola quadrangle: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-58, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: SCGS OFR-58 (DuBar, 1987), geomorphological map of coastal systems in the Dongola quadrangle (Horry and Marion Counties), 1:24,000. Unit names, scarp and auger-hole labels read from the map image (the text layer holds only the title block). Auger hole logs and locality descriptions are on file at SCGS, not on the sheet; cross sections Q1-Q6 are drawn as lines only and are published in DuBar (1987). Surface localities (26-27, 26-30, 26-31, WA 175, WA 179) not itemized. No ages or descriptions printed. SUBSURFACE: none on the sheet.
